title: RBI Bulletin – July 2026
description: Today, the Reserve Bank released the July 2026 issue of its monthly Bulletin. The Bulletin includes two speeches, one article and current statistics. The article is on the State of the Economy. State of the Economy The global economy is continuing with the heightened uncertainties emanating from fragile geopolitics and supply chain pressures.
